blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Deep learning for medical image restoration is often constrained by the need for paired training data. Acquiring perfectly registered clean-noisy radiographs in vivo is impractical due to patient motion and radiation-dose limits. To address this, we employ a self-supervised Noise2Noise paradigm that trains on independently corrupted observations without paired clean images. We propose Denoise X, a lightweight self-supervised U-Net model (7.79M parameters) for suppressing quantum mottle and electronic readout noise in low-dose chest radiographs. It is trained on the NIH ChestX-ray14 dataset (112,120 images) using a stochastic Poisson-Gaussian noise simulator. Zero-shot evaluation on the unseen Montgomery County dataset achieved a PSNR of 36.09 dB and SSIM of 0.8806, outperforming the Bilateral filter while preserving high-frequency anatomical details. Using patch-wise inference, Denoise X processes native-resolution chest radiographs in ~2.2 s per image on a Tesla P100 GPU. Cross-domain evaluation on the Shenzhen dataset achieved 36.44 dB PSNR and 0.9099 SSIM, showing strong generalization. For resource-constrained deployment, the model was converted into a 31.16 MB ONNX model for efficient CPU inference on non-DICOM images.
blocks.zh: 深入学习医疗图像修复往往受到对等培训数据需要的限制. 由于病人的移动和辐射剂量限制,在活体中获取完全注册的无声无声无声的放射图是不切实际的。 为了解决这个问题,我们采用了一个自我监督的噪声2 噪声范式,在独立被腐蚀的观测上进行训练,而不配对干净的图像. 我们提出Denoise X,一种轻量级自控U-Net模型(7.79M参数),用于在低剂量胸腔射电图中压制量子摩特和电子读出噪声. 它在NIH ChestX-ray14数据集(112,120相片)上接受了训练,采用了有花样的波生-高斯噪音模拟器. 对看不见的蒙哥马利县数据集的零镜头评价实现了36.09分贝的PSNR和0.8806分贝的SSIM,在保持高频解剖细节的同时优于双边滤波器. 使用补丁推论,德诺瓦斯X在特斯拉P100GPU上每幅图像以~2.2 s处理本土分辨率的胸腔放射图. 深圳数据集跨域评价实现36.44 dB PSNR和0.9099 SSIM,显示强通. 对于资源受限的部署,该模型被转换为31.16 MB ONNX模型,用于高效地对非DICOM图像的CPU推论.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: The use of chest X-rays is one of the most common forms of medical imaging worldwide and serves as a first-line diagnostic tool for numerous cardiopulmonary disorders [ 8 ] . To ensure patient safety during examinations, radiation exposure should be minimized according to the As Low As Reasonably Achievable (ALARA) principle, which implies minimal exposure of patients to ionizing radiation [ 9 ] . However, any decrease in photon flux necessarily reduces the signal-to-noise ratio of the detector, leading to increased quantum mottle (photon shot noise) and electronic noise that can mask high-frequency anatomical structures [ 9 ] . Therefore, the development of advanced deep learning-based denoising techniques is crucial.
blocks.zh: 胸部X射线的使用是全世界最常见的医学成像形式之一,是众多心肺病的一线诊断工具[8]. 为确保患者在检查期间的安全,应按照 " 尽可能低合理可实现辐射照射(ALARA) " 原则,将辐射照射降至最低,这意味着患者受到电离辐射的照射最小[9]。 然而,光子通量的任何下降必然会降低探测器的信号对噪声比,导致量子摩特(磷射噪声)和电子噪声的增加,可以掩盖高频解剖结构[9]. 因此,开发以学习为基础的高级深层解密技术至关重要。

blocks.en: Traditional spatial filters such as Bilateral [ 1 ] and Median filters are commonly used to address this problem. Despite being computationally inexpensive, these methods rely on local neighborhood statistics and may suppress image noise together with diagnostically important structural edges. In contrast, supervised deep learning frameworks [ 2 , 3 ] have demonstrated promising results in medical image restoration. However, these frameworks face a significant data bottleneck, as obtaining precisely aligned pairs of noisy and clean radiographs is difficult in in-vivo environments due to patient motion and radiation exposure constraints.
blocks.zh: 传统的空间滤波器如双边[1]和中度滤波器通常用于解决这一问题。 尽管这些方法在计算上成本低廉,但依靠当地的邻里统计数据,可能抑制图像噪音和诊断性重要结构边缘。 相反,受监督的深层学习框架[2、3]在恢复医疗形象方面显示出有希望的成果。 然而,这些框架面临一个重大的数据瓶颈,因为由于病人运动和辐射照射限制,在现场环境中很难获得准确对齐的噪音和干净的射电图。

blocks.en: Recent developments in deep learning have led to highly effective frameworks such as vision transformers [ 6 ] and advanced convolutional networks [ 7 ] , which demonstrate excellent performance in image restoration. However, their increased computational complexity may limit their use in resource-constrained healthcare environments. Processing native-resolution, multi-megapixel clinical chest X-rays through such architectures can require substantial computational resources and hardware acceleration.
blocks.zh: 近期深入学习的发展,形成了视觉变换器[6],先进进化网络[7]等高效框架,展现了图像修复的优秀表现. 然而,其计算复杂性的提高可能会限制其在资源有限的保健环境中的使用。 通过这种架构处理本土分辨率,多兆像素临床胸X射线,可能需要大量的计算资源和硬件加速.

blocks.en: The paired-data limitation can be addressed using the Noise2Noise technique [ 4 ] . Given the independence and zero-mean assumption of the radiographic noise, minimizing the Noise2Noise loss can recover the underlying clean signal without requiring clean ground-truth images. Building upon this principle, Denoise X is proposed as a lightweight U-Net architecture trained on the NIH ChestX-ray14 dataset [ 8 ] using a stochastic Poisson–Gaussian noise model [ 10 ] . Additionally, patch-wise inference is employed for native-resolution chest radiography while maintaining compatibility with standard CPU-based deployment.
blocks.zh: 配对数据限制可以使用噪声2噪声技术[4]来解决. 鉴于射线噪声的独立和零目的假设,尽量减少噪声2 噪声损失可以恢复基本的清洁信号,而不需要干净的地面真实图像。 基于这一原则,Denoise X被提议作为NIH胸X射线14数据集培训的轻量级U-Net架构,使用一种有条理的Poisson–Gausian噪声模型[10]. 此外,在保持与基于CPU的标准部署的兼容性的同时,对本体分辨率胸腔放射学采用了补丁推论.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Traditional Methods
blocks.zh: II-A 传统方法

blocks.en: Traditional spatial and frequency domain filtering has been used historically for the elimination of quantum mottle and electronic noise in digital radiography. Filters like Gaussian smoothing, Median filtering, and the Bilateral filter, which has been presented by Tomasi and Manduchi [ 1 ] , are common tools used in clinical radiographic software applications due to their simplicity and minimal computational requirements. Of these, the Bilateral filter is especially useful for edge preservation through local pixel weighting depending on spatial closeness and similarity of intensity values. The limitation of these techniques lies in their reliance on local statistics for noise suppression. Since low-dose chest radiographs often have high noise variance and anatomical edges characterized by low contrast, it leads to unwanted smoothing of high-frequency anatomical structures alongside the noise.
blocks.zh: 传统的空间和频率域过滤在历史上被用于消除数字射线学中的量子摩特和电子噪声. 诸如高斯平滑,中度滤波器,以及双边滤波器等由托马西和曼杜奇[1]介绍的滤波器,由于其简单和最低的计算要求,是临床射线软件应用中常用的工具. 其中,双边滤波器对通过局部像素加权来保持边缘特别有用,这取决于空间近度和强度值的相似性. 这些技术的局限性在于它们依靠当地统计数字来抑制噪音。 由于低剂量胸腔射电图常有高噪声差异和以低反差为特征的解剖边缘,导致高频解剖结构在噪声的同时出现不必要的平滑.

blocks.en: II-B Supervised Image Restoration Using CNN
blocks.zh: II-B 利用CNN监督图像修复

blocks.en: In recent years, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have established strong benchmarks for image restoration tasks. Representative architectures include DnCNN [ 2 ] , proposed by Zhang et al. , which employs residual learning for effective image denoising, and U-Net [ 3 ] , originally proposed by Ronneberger et al. for biomedical image segmentation and subsequently adopted for various image restoration tasks. Both architectures have demonstrated strong capabilities in learning mappings between degraded and restored images. However, despite their effectiveness, their application to medical radiography is fundamentally constrained by the limited availability of paired training data. Supervised learning models typically require large-scale datasets containing precisely aligned noisy and clean image pairs. Although synthetic noise can be introduced into clean images, obtaining real-world paired low-dose and clean radiographs is challenging because repeated acquisitions may differ due to patient motion, physiological variations, and changes in imaging conditions. Furthermore, repeated radiation exposure solely for obtaining paired training data is undesirable from an ethical and clinical perspective..
blocks.zh: 近年来,革命神经网络(CNN)为图像修复任务制定了强有力的基准. 代表性建筑包括张某1等人提出的DnCNN[2],该建筑采用剩余学习方法有效进行图像解析;U-Net[3],最初由Ronneberger等人提出,用于生物医学图像分解,后用于各种图像修复任务. 这两个建筑都表现出了学习退化图像与恢复图像之间的绘图的强大能力。 然而,尽管它们很有效,但由于配对培训数据有限,它们在医学放射学方面的应用受到根本限制。 监督学习模型通常需要包含精确对齐的噪音和干净图像对的大型数据集. 虽然合成噪声可以引入干净的图像,但获得现实世界配对的低剂量和干净的射电图具有挑战性,因为反复获得可能因病人运动,生理变化,以及成像条件的变化而有所不同. 此外,从伦理和临床的角度来看,仅仅为了获得配对培训数据而重复的辐射照射是不可取的。

blocks.en: II-C Self-Supervised Image Restoration
blocks.zh: II-C 自我监督图像修复

blocks.en: One solution to the problem above is to use self-supervised image restoration approaches. Lehtinen et al. [ 4 ] proposed a Noise2Noise approach in which a neural network learns image restoration from independently corrupted samples of the same scene. Under the assumption of having zero-mean and statistically independent corrupting noise over observations, the optimization procedure with the L 2 L_{2} loss leads to the expected result of the image without any noise. Following the idea described above, Noise2Void approach suggested by Krull et al. [ 5 ] extended it by allowing training from one single image with noise, though usually sacrificing restoration quality. Such learning approaches are especially useful in case of medical imaging since getting such a clean image is usually impossible.
blocks.zh: 以上问题的一个解决方案是采用自我监督的图像修复方法. Lehtinen等人著. [4]提出了一种噪声2噪声方法,神经网络从同一场景的独立腐烂的样本中学习图像修复. 在以零度和统计上独立的腐蚀性噪音凌驾于观测之上的假设下,与L2 L_{2}损失的优化程序导致图像的预期结果没有任何噪音. 根据上述想法,Krull等人提出了Noise2Void方法。 [5] 扩展了它,允许从一个有噪音的图像进行训练,虽然通常会牺牲修复质量. 这种学习方法对于医学成像特别有用,因为获得这种干净的图像通常是不可能的。

blocks.en: II-D Modern Restoration Architectures
blocks.zh: II-D 现代修复建筑

blocks.en: New developments in image restoration tasks have led to the creation of increasingly complex deep learning architectures with the ability to achieve state-of-the-art results. For instance, Restormer [ 6 ] , an architecture proposed by Zamir et al. , uses efficient multi-head self-attention models in a transformer architecture for high-quality image restoration, whereas NAFNet [ 7 ] , proposed by Chen et al. , is a computationally efficient architecture which uses convolutional layers and does not use any nonlinear activation functions yet still retains high restoration capabilities. While these architectures provide impressive results on natural image benchmarks, the computational burden of these architectures makes their usage challenging in resource-limited clinical settings. As medical radiographs are captured at native multi-megapixel resolutions, it is computationally demanding to process these high-resolution images using transformer architectures and very deep convolutional networks.
blocks.zh: 图像修复任务的新发展,造就了越来越复杂的深层学习建筑,具有实现先进成果的能力. 例如,Zamir等人提议的重聚器[6],在变压器结构中采用高效的多头自留模型,用于高质量的图像恢复,而Chen等人提议的NAFNet[7],是一种计算效率的建筑,使用演化层,不使用任何非线性激活功能,但仍保留高的恢复能力。 虽然这些架构为自然图像基准提供了令人印象深刻的结果,但这些架构的计算负担使得它们在资源有限的临床环境中的使用具有挑战性. 由于医学射电图在原生多兆像素分辨率中被捕获,因此在计算上要求使用变压器架构和非常深的演化网络处理这些高分辨率图像.

blocks.en: II-E Research Gap
blocks.zh: II-E 研究差距

blocks.en: Although significant advances have been made in image restoration tasks through existing methods, they either rely on paired supervised learning or are highly computationally intensive making their practical use in a clinical setting difficult. Due to these shortcomings, Denoise X is introduced as a light-weight self-supervised U-Net architecture that integrates the Noise2Noise learning philosophy with an efficient patch-based inference mechanism for restoration of native-resolution chest radiographs. The proposed model is designed to preserve clinically significant anatomical details while ensuring practical implementation on low-end hardware systems.
blocks.zh: 虽然通过现有方法在图像修复任务方面取得了显著进展,但它们要么依靠对齐的有监督的学习,要么在计算上高度密集,难以在临床环境中实际使用。 由于这些缺点,Denoise X被引入为轻量级自控的U-Net架构,将噪声2Noise学习哲学与高效的补丁基推论机制相结合,用于恢复本土分辨率的胸腔放射图. 拟议模型旨在保存临床上重要的解剖细节,同时确保低端硬件系统的实际实施.

blocks.en: III Proposed Methodology
blocks.zh: 三. 拟议方法

blocks.en: This section describes the methodology for the development and deployment of the Denoise X framework. Overall, the methodology consists of three main steps: data and noise simulation, self-supervised denoising, and high-resolution inference and deployment. First, the NIH ChestX-ray14 database is used to generate independent noisy observations via a stochastic Poisson-Gaussian noise model, thus enabling realistic quantum mottle and electronic noise simulation without paired clinical acquisitions. The noisy observations are then used in a Noise2Noise paradigm to train a lightweight U-Net regularized by an L 1 L_{1} loss to recover the underlying clean image from the noisy input. Finally, the trained model is deployed using a patch-wise inference strategy to enable high-resolution radiograph processing and accelerated by ONNX for CPU inference in low-resource settings. The following subsections describe the details of each step.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍Denoise X框架的制定和部署方法。 总的来说,该方法包括三个主要步骤:数据和噪音模拟,自我监督的去诺,以及高分辨率的推论和部署. 首先,NIH ChestX-ray14数据库被用来通过一个浮雕的Poisson-Goussian噪声模型产生独立的噪音观测,从而使得现实的量子摩尔和电子噪声模拟无需对齐临床收购. 以L1 LQQ1}损失来从噪音输入中恢复基本的清洁图像。 最后,训练有素的模型使用补丁推论策略进行部署,以便能够进行高分辨率的放射图处理,并由ONNX加速在低资源环境下的CPU推论. 以下各小节叙述每一步骤的细节。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: End-to-end workflow of the proposed Denoise X framework. The pipeline illustrates stochastic Poisson–Gaussian noise simulation for Noise2Noise training, self-supervised U-Net optimization, and deployment using GPU-based patch-wise inference and ONNX-based CPU inference.

blocks.en: III-A Modeling of Physical Noise
blocks.zh: III-A 物理噪声建模

blocks.en: The capturing of digital chest x-rays basically depends on the measurement of X-ray photons. In order to ensure safety as per the clinical radiation protocols, the amount of photons is limited. The degradation that results due to the low dose radiography process is basically Quantum Mottle. This is because it originates due to random photon arrival and hence follows the Poisson statistics. This degradation is further affected by the Gaussian distribution of electronic readout noise due to the digital detector device.
blocks.zh: 数码胸X射线的捕捉基本取决于X射线光子的测量. 为了按照临床辐射协议保证安全,光子的数量是有限的. 低剂量射线过程导致的降解基本上是量子摩托. 这是因为它源于随机光子到达,从而遵循了普瓦松统计. 由于数字探测器设备,高斯分配电子读出噪声进一步影响了这种退化.

blocks.en: III-B Self-Supervised Noise2Noise Learning Framework
blocks.zh: III-B 自我监督噪音2 噪音学习框架

blocks.en: In traditional image denoising, pairs of perfectly aligned noisy and noise-free reference images are used for supervised training. In order to solve this problem, the self-supervised Noise2Noise framework is used. Unlike supervised denoising, where the ground truth targets are required for training, the network is trained using two independently corrupted copies of the same image.
blocks.zh: 在传统的图像调音中,有对完全对齐的噪音和无噪音的参考图像用于监督培训。 为了解决这个问题,采用了自我监督的Noise2Noise框架. 与受监督的虚名,即训练需要地面真相目标的情况不同,网络使用两个独立腐败的同图像拷贝进行训练.

blocks.en: Let y y be the latent image without any form of noise, and let x 1 x_{1} and x 2 x_{2} be two noisy observations generated using the stochastic Poisson-Gaussian model for noise generation as follows: x 1 \displaystyle x_{1} = y + n 1 , \displaystyle=y+n_{1}, (2) x 2 \displaystyle x_{2} = y + n 2 . \displaystyle=y+n_{2}. where n 1 n_{1} and n 2 n_{2} represent independent observations of the compound noise process. In the training phase, the input to the network is x 1 x_{1} , while x 2 x_{2} is used as the target observation.
blocks.zh: 让 y 成为没有任何形式噪音的潜在图像, 让 x 1 x x x x x x x x x x x x x x x x x x } 成为使用 stochtical Poisson- Gousisian 模型生成的两种噪音生成的噪音的观测数据如下: x 1\ displaystyle x\ 1} = y + n 1,\ displaystyle=y+n\ 1}, (2) x 2\ displaystyle x\ 2} = y + n\ 2\ displaystyle=y+n\ 2} 其中n 1 n_{1}和n 2 n_{2}代表对复合噪声过程的独立观测. 在训练阶段,对网络的输入是x1 x_{1},而x2 x_{2}则被用作目标观察.

blocks.en: The network f θ ​ ( ⋅ ) f_{\theta}(\cdot) , characterized by learnable weights θ \theta , is optimized by minimizing the mean absolute error between its prediction and the second noisy observation :
blocks.zh: 以可学习的权重为特征的 f 网络 f ( ) f \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ ) 被优化, 将它的预测和第二声响的观测之间的平均绝对错误最小化 :

blocks.en: ℒ ⁡ ( θ ) = 𝔼 ⁡ [ ‖ f θ ​ ( x 1 ) − x 2 ‖ 1 ] . \mathcal{L}(\theta)=\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|f_{\theta}(x_{1})-x_{2}\right\|_{1}\right]. (3)

where ℒ ⁡ ( θ ) \mathcal{L}(\theta) denotes the objective loss function, and 𝔼 ⁡ [ ⋅ ] \mathbb{E}[\cdot] represents the statistical expectation operator over the training data distribution.
Given the assumption that the corruption is independent of each other and that its mean is zero, the expected value of the target corrupted with noise will be equal to the expected value of the source. Hence, by optimizing for the Noise2Noise loss function, we converge to the same expected value as with traditional supervised learning.

鉴于腐败相互独立且其平均值为零的假设,被噪声腐蚀的目标的预期价值将等于来源的预期价值. 因此,通过优化噪声损失功能,我们与传统监督学习的预期价值一致。

blocks.en: This property of the loss function makes it very suitable for medical imaging applications, where it is impossible from both physical and ethical points of view to have pairs of clean and corrupted radiographs. The learning framework is realized using a simple U-Net architecture aimed at preserving the anatomical features.
blocks.zh: 损失功能的这种属性使得它非常适合医学成像应用,从物理和伦理的角度来看都不可能有一对干净和腐败的放射图. 学习框架是使用一个简单的U-Net架构实现的,旨在保存解剖特征.

blocks.en: III-C Denoise X Network Architecture
blocks.zh: III-C Denoise X网络架构

blocks.en: To infer the underlying anatomical signal from the observation, a lightweight fully convolutional U-Net architecture is used. The network uses a single channel grayscale tensor of spatial size 256 × 256 256\times 256 as the input and generates a restored tensor of spatial size 256 × 256 256\times 256 .
blocks.zh: 为了推断从观测中得出的基本的解剖信号,采用了一种轻量级完全演化的U-Net架构. 网络采用空间大小256×256256\times 256的单通道灰度拉伸器作为输入,并生成空间大小256×256256\times 256的恢复拉伸器.

blocks.en: The network architecture is symmetric in nature with an encoder-decoder structure: • Encoder: The architecture gradually down-samples the spatial resolution while simultaneously increasing the depth of the feature channels and capturing the high-level structure representation of the anatomy. • Bottleneck: This acts as a link between the encoder and decoder pathways which performs operation on the most down-sampled feature maps. • Decoder: Gradually up-samples the feature representation to reconstruct the spatial resolution. • Skip Connections: In order to avoid the loss of the finer spatial resolution (fine anatomical structures like vascular structures in lung, rib margins, soft tissue interfaces) due to down-sampling, skip connections are made.
blocks.zh: 网络架构在性质上是对称的,具有编码器-解码器结构: • 编码器: 架构逐渐下图空间分辨率,同时增加特征通道的深度,并捕捉解剖学的高层次结构代表. • 支助 Bottleneck : (原始内容存档于2018-09-29). 这在编码器和解码器路径之间起到连接作用,这些路径在最下游的特征图上进行操作。 • 支助 解码器:逐渐向上标出特征表现以重建空间分辨率. • 支助 跳过连接 : 为了避免由于下采样而失去更细的空间分辨率(肺部血管结构,肋骨边缘,软组织界面等细细的解剖结构),跳过连接进行.

blocks.en: Encoder: The architecture gradually down-samples the spatial resolution while simultaneously increasing the depth of the feature channels and capturing the high-level structure representation of the anatomy.
blocks.zh: 编码器 : 建筑逐渐向下标出空间分辨率,同时增加特征通道的深度,并捕捉解剖学的高层次结构代表.

blocks.en: Bottleneck: This acts as a link between the encoder and decoder pathways which performs operation on the most down-sampled feature maps.
blocks.zh: Bottleneck : (原始内容存档于2018-09-29). 这在编码器和解码器路径之间起到连接作用,这些路径在最下游的特征图上进行操作。

blocks.en: Decoder: Gradually up-samples the feature representation to reconstruct the spatial resolution.
blocks.zh: 解码器:逐渐向上标出特征表现以重建空间分辨率.

blocks.en: Skip Connections: In order to avoid the loss of the finer spatial resolution (fine anatomical structures like vascular structures in lung, rib margins, soft tissue interfaces) due to down-sampling, skip connections are made.
blocks.zh: 跳过连接 : 为了避免由于下采样而失去更细的空间分辨率(肺部血管结构,肋骨边缘,软组织界面等细细的解剖结构),跳过连接进行.

blocks.en: This kind of architecture allows the network to exploit both localized high-frequency information as well as anatomical context information. The suggested architecture involves around 7.79 million trainable parameters , which offer enough representational power to restore anatomical structures and yet remain lightweight to be deployable both on GPUs and CPUs. Contrary to other medical image restoration methods using transformers, the suggested architecture consists only of convolutional layers and has lower computational complexity.
blocks.zh: 这种架构使网络能够利用本地化的高频信息以及解剖背景信息。 建议的建筑涉及约779万个可训练参数,这些参数提供了足够的代表性力量,可以恢复解剖结构,但仍保持轻量级,可以部署在GPU和CPU上。 与其他使用变压器的医学图像修复方法相反,建议的架构仅由演化层组成,计算复杂性较低.

blocks.en: III-D Patch-Based High-Resolution Inference
blocks.zh: 以补丁为基础的高分辨率推论

blocks.en: One of the problems associated with medical image restoration is the difference between fixed network input dimensions and resolution of native clinical radiographs. In many practical cases, downsampling of high-resolution images is done because of limited memory, thus losing important high-frequency information, quantum mottle, and anatomical edges.
blocks.zh: 与医疗图像修复有关的问题之一是固定网络输入维度与本土临床射电图分辨率的区别. 在许多实际情况下,由于内存有限,对高分辨率图像进行了下取样,从而失去了重要的高频信息,量子摩特,解剖边缘.

blocks.en: To perform inference on multi-megapixel native chest radiographs without global downsampling, a high-resolution patch-wise inference strategy is employed. The inference process runs in sequence according to the following steps: 1. Reflect Padding: The native full-resolution image gets dynamically padded with reflect padding such that both dimensions get perfectly divisible by the 256 × 256 256\times 256 window size, avoiding border artifacts due to convolution. 2. Patch Extraction: The padded image is then extracted in non-overlapping 256 × 256 256\times 256 spatial patches with a stride of 256 pixels in both dimensions. 3. Batch Inference: These patches are grouped in one tensor for batch inference in the U-Net model. 4. Patch Reconstruction: The reconstructed patches are then concatenated to form a continuous high-resolution matrix, and the reflection padding applied at the beginning is trimmed, resulting in the final native size of the image.
blocks.zh: 为了对多兆像素的原生胸腔放射图进行推论,而不进行全局下取样,采用了高分辨率的补丁推论策略. 推论过程按以下步骤依次进行: 1. 1. 铺垫: 原生的全分辨率图像得到动态加载的反射粘贴,使两个维度都完全被256×256256\time256的窗口大小所分散,避免了因曲折而形成的边框文物. 2. 补丁提取器: 然后在非重叠的256×256\times 256个空间补丁中提取加成的图像,两个维度的步数为256像素. 3. 批量推论: 这些补丁被分组成一个百分数,用于U-Net模型中的批量推论. 4. 补丁重建: 重建的补丁随后被凝结,形成连续的高分辨率矩阵,最初应用的反射垫被修剪,导致图像的最终本土尺寸.

blocks.en: Reflect Padding: The native full-resolution image gets dynamically padded with reflect padding such that both dimensions get perfectly divisible by the 256 × 256 256\times 256 window size, avoiding border artifacts due to convolution.
blocks.zh: 显示板 : 原生的全分辨率图像得到动态加载的反射粘贴,使两个维度都完全被256×256256\time256的窗口大小所分散,避免了因曲折而形成的边框文物.

blocks.en: Patch Extraction: The padded image is then extracted in non-overlapping 256 × 256 256\times 256 spatial patches with a stride of 256 pixels in both dimensions.
blocks.zh: 补丁提取 : 然后在非重叠的256×256\times 256个空间补丁中提取加成的图像,两个维度的步数为256像素.

blocks.en: Batch Inference: These patches are grouped in one tensor for batch inference in the U-Net model.
blocks.zh: 批量推断 : 这些补丁被分组成一个百分数,用于U-Net模型中的批量推论.

blocks.en: Patch Reconstruction: The reconstructed patches are then concatenated to form a continuous high-resolution matrix, and the reflection padding applied at the beginning is trimmed, resulting in the final native size of the image.
blocks.zh: 补丁重建 : 重建的补丁随后被凝结,形成连续的高分辨率矩阵,最初应用的反射垫被修剪,导致图像的最终本土尺寸.

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Architecture of the proposed Denoise X U-Net. The network follows a symmetric encoder–decoder architecture with skip connections that preserve fine-grained anatomical details during image restoration.
blocks.zh: 费格。 2: 拟议的Denoise X U-Net的架构。 网络遵循一个对称的编码器–解码器架构,带有跳过连接,在图像修复过程中保留精细的解剖细节.

blocks.en: This technique allows the network to focus on restoring the structure of the image at the native resolution, while still being able to infer on any size of the radiograph without changing the training of the network.
blocks.zh: 这种技术使得网络能够专注于恢复原生分辨率的图像结构,同时仍然能够推断出无线电图的任何大小而不改变网络的训练.

blocks.en: III-E Edge Deployment Pipeline
blocks.zh: 三-E 边际部署管道

blocks.en: To ensure the clinical feasibility of the proposed framework, the model trained in TensorFlow is exported to the Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) format. The exported ONNX model takes up a mere 31.16 MB , which allows for CPU inference without any need for the TensorFlow library.
blocks.zh: 为确保拟议框架的临床可行性,以TensorFlow培训的模型被输出到开放神经网络交换(ONNX)格式. 输出的ONNX型号仅占用了31.16 MB,这使得CPU无需TensorFlow库即可推论.

blocks.en: In addition, to speed up the inference for mobile and web applications, a preprocessing pipeline for the client-side HTML5 Canvas input is implemented. The preprocessing ensures that extreme resolution images have their dimensions limited to 2048 pixels (except DICOM images, which are passed natively) while maintaining the original aspect ratio. Thus, the number of inference patches is considerably reduced, allowing native CPU inference of the patch-wise restoration algorithm in about 3 to 5 seconds per image without any dedicated GPU hardware.
blocks.zh: 此外,为加快移动和网络应用的推论,还实施了客户端HTML5 Canvas输入的预处理管道. 预处理可确保极端分辨率图像的尺寸限制在2048像素(除DICOM图像外,这些图像是本土传承的),同时保持原宽比. 因此,推论补丁的数量大为减少,允许本地CPU在每幅图像中大约3至5秒内对补丁的恢复算法进行推论,而没有任何专门的GPU硬件.

blocks.en: IV Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 四. 实验和结果

blocks.en: IV-A Datasets and Performance Metrics
blocks.zh: 数据集和性能计量

blocks.en: Experiments to evaluate the proposed Denoise X framework were conducted on three publicly available chest radiograph datasets:
blocks.zh: 评估提议的Denoise的实验 X框架是在三个公开的胸射线数据集上进行的:

blocks.en: 1. Training (NIH ChestX-ray14 [ 8 ] ): The network was trained on 112,120 chest radiographs. The proposed stochastic Poisson–Gaussian noise model generated Noise2Noise training image pairs. 2. Zero-shot Quantitative Evaluation (Montgomery County Dataset [ 11 ] ): A total of 138 chest radiographs were used for zero-shot evaluation to assess the model’s generalization capability. 3. Cross-domain Validation (Shenzhen Dataset [ 12 ] ): Additional validation was performed on an unseen chest radiograph from the Shenzhen Hospital dataset to evaluate cross-domain generalization under a different imaging distribution.
blocks.zh: 1. 培训(NIH胸X射线14[8]): 该网络接受了112,120个胸腔放射图的培训。 拟议的stochastic Poisson–Gausian噪声模型产生了噪声2Noise训练图像对. 2.零射量评价(蒙哥马利县数据集[11]): 共有138台胸膛放射图用于零发评价,以评估模型的通缩能力. 3.跨域验证(深圳数据集[12]):在深圳医院数据集的隐形胸腔放射图上进行了额外验证,以不同成像分布下评价跨域通用.

blocks.en: Training (NIH ChestX-ray14 [ 8 ] ): The network was trained on 112,120 chest radiographs. The proposed stochastic Poisson–Gaussian noise model generated Noise2Noise training image pairs.
blocks.zh: 训练(NIH胸X射线14 [8]): 该网络接受了112,120个胸腔放射图的培训。 拟议的stochastic Poisson–Gausian噪声模型产生了噪声2Noise训练图像对.

blocks.en: Zero-shot Quantitative Evaluation (Montgomery County Dataset [ 11 ] ): A total of 138 chest radiographs were used for zero-shot evaluation to assess the model’s generalization capability.
blocks.zh: 零射量评价(蒙哥马利县数据集[11]): 共有138台胸膛放射图用于零发评价,以评估模型的通缩能力.

blocks.en: Cross-domain Validation (Shenzhen Dataset [ 12 ] ): Additional validation was performed on an unseen chest radiograph from the Shenzhen Hospital dataset to evaluate cross-domain generalization under a different imaging distribution.
blocks.zh: 跨域验证(深圳数据集[12] ):在深圳医院数据集的隐形胸腔放射图上进行了额外验证,以评价不同成像分布下的跨域通用性.

blocks.en: The Montgomery and Shenzhen datasets were used exclusively for evaluation and were not included during training, ensuring an unbiased assessment of zero-shot restoration capability and cross-domain generalization.
blocks.zh: 蒙哥马利和深圳的数据集专门用于评价,在培训期间没有列入,确保了零射恢复能力和跨域通用的无偏见评估.

blocks.en: Image restoration quality was evaluated using two widely adopted performance metrics: the Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), which measures pixel-level reconstruction accuracy, and the Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM), which evaluates structural similarity, local contrast, and anatomical detail preservation.
blocks.zh: 图像恢复质量是通过两个广泛采用的性能度量评价的:衡量像素级重建精度的峰信号对噪声比(PSNR),以及评价结构相似性,局部对比度,解剖细节保存的结构相似性指数度量(SSIM).

blocks.en: IV-B Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 四-B 执行详情

blocks.en: The proposed Denoise X U-Net architecture, comprising approximately 7.79 million trainable parameters, was implemented and evaluated using an NVIDIA Tesla P100 GPU. Gaussian, Median, and Bilateral filters were implemented using standard CPU-based libraries. To investigate deployment in resource-constrained environments, the trained TensorFlow model was converted into a lightweight 31.16 MB ONNX model for CPU inference.
blocks.zh: 拟议的Denoise X U-Net架构由大约779万个可培训参数组成,使用NVIDIA Tesla P100 GPU加以实施和评价。 Gaussian,Medien,以及双边过滤器都是使用基于标准CPU的库执行的. 为了调查在资源受限环境中的部署,训练有素的TensorFlow模型被转换为轻量级31.16 MB ONNX模型用于CPU推论.

blocks.en: IV-C Quantitative Assessment
blocks.zh: IV-C 定量评估

blocks.en: Table II presents the comparative performance of the proposed method against classical filtering techniques on the unseen Montgomery County dataset [ 11 ] . The artificially degraded input images exhibited an average SSIM of 0.1300, indicating severe degradation caused by simulated quantum mottle. Among the classical filtering approaches, the Bilateral filter achieved the best baseline performance with a PSNR of 31.03 dB and an SSIM of 0.6431. However, because it relies on neighborhood statistics, it tends to smooth fine anatomical structures together with image noise, resulting in noticeable edge blurring, as shown in Fig. 3 (c)
blocks.zh: 表二列出了在看不见的蒙哥马利县数据集上与古典过滤技术相比的拟议方法的比较性能[11]. 人工退化的输入图像显示平均为0.1300的SSIM,表明模拟量子运动引起的严重退化。 在传统的过滤方法中,双边过滤器以31.03 dB的PSNR和0.6431的SSIM实现了最佳基线性能. 然而,由于它依赖于邻里统计,它往往平滑细微的解剖结构与图像噪声,导致显著的边缘模糊,如图3(c)所示.

blocks.en: The proposed Denoise X framework outperformed all baseline methods, achieving a PSNR of 36.09 dB and an SSIM of 0.8806. This corresponds to an SSIM improvement of +0.2375 over the best baseline, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed self-supervised framework in suppressing Poisson–Gaussian noise while preserving diagnostically important anatomical structures, as shown in Fig. 3 (d). These quantitative results confirm that the proposed restoration framework achieves a favorable balance between effective noise suppression and preservation of diagnostically relevant image structures, consistently outperforming conventional filtering techniques on previously unseen chest radiographs.
blocks.zh: 德诺瓦斯 X框架的绩效超过了所有基准方法,实现了36.09 dB的PSNR和0.8806的SSIM. 这相当于比最佳基线的+0.2375的SSIM改进,表明拟议的自我监督框架在抑制波森-古西语噪音的同时保留诊断性重要解剖结构的有效性,如图3(d)所示。 这些量化结果证实,拟议的恢复框架在有效抑制噪音和保持诊断性相关图像结构之间取得了有利的平衡,在先前未见的胸腔射线图上,传统过滤技术一直比传统过滤技术好。

blocks.en: IV-D Generalization across Datasets
blocks.zh: 四-D 跨数据集的通用

blocks.en: For testing generalization performance outside the NIH ChestX-ray14 [ 8 ] and Montgomery County [ 11 ] datasets, cross-domain testing was performed on an unseen chest radiograph from the Shenzhen Hospital dataset [ 12 ] . As shown in Table III , Denoise X yielded a PSNR of 36.44 dB and an SSIM of 0.9099, which were significantly better than those of the Bilateral filter, which achieved an SSIM of 0.7493. These results suggest that the proposed stochastic Poisson–Gaussian noise model facilitates the learning of generalized anatomical representations, even under varying clinical image distributions and acquisition systems.
blocks.zh: 为测试NIH胸X射线14[8]和蒙哥马利县[11]数据集外的通用化性能,在深圳医院数据集的一张隐形胸腔放射图上进行了跨域测试[12]. 如表三所示,Denoise X生产了36.44 dB的PSNR和0.9099的SSIM,大大优于双边过滤器,后者实现了0.7493的SSIM. 这些结果表明,拟议的Stochtical Poisson - Gausian噪声模型有助于学习普遍的解剖表达,即使在不同的临床图像分布和获取系统下也是如此.

blocks.en: IV-E Computational Complexity and Deployment Analysis
blocks.zh: 计算复杂性和部署分析

blocks.en: One of the main objectives of the proposed framework is to enable deployment in resource-constrained clinical settings.. Running inference on native high-resolution multi-megapixel chest radiographs using the proposed patch-based inference method takes roughly 2.2 s per image on NVIDIA Tesla P100 GPU (Table II ). Running the same native resolution inference method using ONNX model on a regular CPU will increase the inference time to about 120 s per radiograph.
blocks.zh: 拟议框架的主要目标之一是在资源紧张的临床环境中进行部署。 在NVIDIA Tesla P100 GPU上,使用拟议的补丁推论方法对本地高分辨率多兆像素胸腔放射图进行推论,每幅图像大约需要2.2s(表二)。 使用 ONNX 模型在普通CPU 上运行相同的本地解析推论方法,将使推论时间增加到每幅射电图120秒左右.

blocks.en: However, such latency becomes undesirable for mobile and point-of-care applications, which require optimizations.To address this limitation, an adaptive preprocessing stage was implemented to dynamically scale extreme-resolution images of the extreme-resolution images obtained from the mobile device in either a normal JPEG or PNG format, with a maximum of 2048 pixels while maintaining the aspect ratio intact. This helps to cut down the number of inference patches from about 192 to 48, thus reducing the time taken by ONNX CPU inference from about 120 seconds to merely 3–5 seconds , all without using any GPU. Native DICOM medical images bypass this scaling step to preserve their raw, uncompressed bit-depth and structural fidelity.
blocks.zh: 然而,对于流动和护理点的应用来说,这种延迟变得不可取,需要优化。 为解决这一限制,采用了一个适应性预处理阶段,以动态尺度对从移动设备中以普通的JPEG或PNG格式获得的极端分辨率图像的极端分辨率图像进行优化处理,最高可达到2048像素,同时保持宽比完整. 这有助于将推论补丁的数量从大约192个减少到48个,从而将ONNX CPU推论所用的时间从大约120秒减少到仅仅3–5秒,都不用任何GPU. 原生的DICOM医疗图像绕过这个缩放步骤来保存其原始的,不压缩的位深和结构上的忠心.

blocks.en: V Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed Denoise X architecture in bridging high-quality medical image restoration with the constraints of edge deployment. Using the self-supervised Noise2Noise approach, the network effectively suppresses quantum mottle and electronic readout noise without requiring paired ground-truth radiographs.
blocks.zh: 实验结果表明,拟议的Denoise X架构在利用边缘部署的制约因素连接高质量医疗图像修复方面的效力。 该网络采用自我监督的Noise2Noise方法,有效压制量子调音器和电子读出噪音,而不需要配对的地面真人放射图。

blocks.en: From a clinical perspective, preserving high-frequency anatomical structures is essential. Classical methods such as the Bilateral filter rely on local statistics and, although they reduce noise, can blur fine anatomical structures, as reflected by an SSIM of 0.6431 on the Montgomery County dataset [ 11 ] . In contrast, the proposed U-Net achieved an SSIM of 0.8806, indicating improved preservation of structural information, including pulmonary vasculature and bony structures. Furthermore, cross-dataset evaluation on the Shenzhen dataset [ 12 ] , with an SSIM of 0.9099, demonstrates promising generalization across different imaging distributions and acquisition systems through the proposed stochastic Poisson–Gaussian noise simulation.
blocks.zh: 从临床角度看,保留高频解剖结构至关重要。 双边滤波器等古典方法依靠地方统计数据,虽然可以减少噪音,但可以模糊精细的解剖结构,这体现在蒙哥马利县数据集上的0.6431的SSIM[11]上. 相比之下,拟议的U-Net实现了0.8806的SSIM,表明结构信息的保存情况有所改善,包括肺脏和骨骼结构。 此外,对深圳数据集的跨数据集评价(SSIM为0.9099)表明,通过拟议的Stochtic Poisson-Gausisan噪声模拟,对不同成像分布和获取系统进行有希望的概括。

blocks.en: The 31.16 MB ONNX patch-wise inference pipeline addresses a major challenge in deploying AI-based restoration systems in resource-constrained environments. While modern transformer architectures often require substantial computational resources, inference on native-resolution images using the ONNX model takes approximately 120 seconds per radiograph on a CPU, which may be suitable for asynchronous workflows. More importantly, the adaptive client-side preprocessing module downsizes high-resolution non-DICOM images to a maximum of 2048 px, reducing the number of inference patches and lowering CPU inference time to approximately 3–5 seconds.
blocks.zh: 31.16 MB ONNX 补丁推导管处理在资源限制环境中部署基于AI的恢复系统方面的重大挑战。 虽然现代变压器架构往往需要大量的计算资源,但使用ONNX模型对本土分辨率图像的推论在CPU上每幅放射图大约需要120秒,这可能适合同步工作流程. 更重要的是,适应性的客户端预处理模块将高分辨率的非DICOM图像缩小到最多2048 px,减少了推论补丁的数量,将CPU推论时间降低到约3–5秒.

blocks.en: V-A Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: V-A 限制和未来的工作

blocks.en: While the proposed Denoise X framework demonstrates promising performance, several limitations remain:
blocks.zh: 德诺瓦斯的提议 X框架显示业绩良好,但仍存在若干限制:

blocks.en: 1. Synthetic Noise Approximation: The stochastic Poisson–Gaussian model closely approximates quantum mottle but cannot fully represent all scanner-specific and real-world clinical noise characteristics. 2. Clinical Validation: Although PSNR and SSIM indicate strong restoration quality, future work will include radiologist-based Mean Opinion Score (MOS) studies to assess diagnostic usefulness. 3. Generalization: Future research will evaluate the framework on images acquired from different imaging systems and clinical environments to improve robustness. 4. Model Enhancement: Lightweight attention mechanisms and further optimization will be explored to improve structural preservation while maintaining efficient edge deployment.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 合成噪声 : 斯图克特式的Poisson–Gousisan模型紧密近似于量子运动,但不能完全代表所有扫描仪特有的和真实世界的临床噪声特征. 2. 临床鉴定: 虽然PSNR和SSIM表明恢复质量很强,但今后的工作将包括以放射学家为基础的“平均意见分数”研究,以评估诊断效用。 3. 概论: 今后的研究将评价从不同成像系统和临床环境中获取的图像的框架,以提高稳健性。 4. 模型增强:将探索轻量级关注机制和进一步优化,以改进结构保护,同时保持高效的边缘部署。

blocks.en: Synthetic Noise Approximation: The stochastic Poisson–Gaussian model closely approximates quantum mottle but cannot fully represent all scanner-specific and real-world clinical noise characteristics.
blocks.zh: 合成噪声 : 斯图克特式的Poisson–Gousisan模型紧密近似于量子运动,但不能完全代表所有扫描仪特有的和真实世界的临床噪声特征.

blocks.en: Clinical Validation: Although PSNR and SSIM indicate strong restoration quality, future work will include radiologist-based Mean Opinion Score (MOS) studies to assess diagnostic usefulness.
blocks.zh: 临床鉴定: 虽然PSNR和SSIM表明恢复质量很强,但今后的工作将包括以放射学家为基础的“平均意见分数”研究,以评估诊断效用。

blocks.en: Generalization: Future research will evaluate the framework on images acquired from different imaging systems and clinical environments to improve robustness.
blocks.zh: 概论: 今后的研究将评价从不同成像系统和临床环境中获取的图像的框架,以提高稳健性。

blocks.en: Model Enhancement: Lightweight attention mechanisms and further optimization will be explored to improve structural preservation while maintaining efficient edge deployment.
blocks.zh: 模型增强: 将探索轻量级关注机制和进一步优化,以改善结构保存,同时保持高效的边缘部署.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, Denoise X was introduced as a self-supervised, edge-deployable U-Net architecture for suppressing quantum mottle and electronic readout noise in low-dose chest radiographs. The integration of stochastic Poisson–Gaussian noise generation with the Noise2Noise learning paradigm enables training without requiring perfectly paired clean and noisy clinical radiographs.
blocks.zh: 在这篇论文中,德诺瓦兹X被引入为一种自我监督,边缘可部署的U-Net架构,用于压制低剂量胸腔射电图中的量子模和电子读出噪声. 斯图克特·普瓦松-古斯西语噪声的产生与噪声学范式相结合,使得培训无需完美配对的干净而吵闹的临床无线电图即可进行。

blocks.en: Zero-shot evaluation on the unseen Montgomery County dataset [ 11 ] demonstrated that the 7.79-million-parameter network substantially outperformed the evaluated classical spatial filtering methods. Denoise X achieved a PSNR of 36.09 dB and an SSIM of 0.8806, compared with 31.03 dB and 0.6431, respectively, for the Bilateral filter, while preserving diagnostically important high-frequency anatomical structures. Furthermore, cross-domain evaluation on the unseen Shenzhen dataset [ 12 ] achieved a PSNR of 36.44 dB and an SSIM of 0.9099, indicating promising generalization across different imaging distributions.
blocks.zh: 对看不见的蒙哥马利县数据集的零镜头评价[11]表明,779万参数的网络大大超过了所评价的古典空间过滤方法。 德诺瓦斯 X实现了36.09 dB的PSNR和0.8806的SSIM,而双边滤波器分别为31.03 dB和0.6431,同时保留了诊断性重要的高频解剖结构. 此外,对未见的深圳数据集的跨域评价,实现了36.44 dB的PSNR和0.9099的SSIM,表明对不同成像分布的可喜概括。

blocks.en: In addition, the proposed framework addresses computational constraints associated with deployment in resource-limited clinical environments. By combining patch-based inference with conversion to a lightweight 31.16 MB ONNX model, Denoise X enables high-resolution radiograph restoration using CPU-based inference. These results demonstrate the potential of the proposed framework for practical edge deployment while providing a foundation for future validation using real low-dose clinical data and radiologist-based assessment.
blocks.zh: 此外,拟议框架还处理与在资源有限的临床环境中部署有关的计算制约因素。 通过将基于补丁的推论与转换为轻量级31.16 MB ONNX模型相结合,Denoise X可以使用基于CPU的推论进行高分辨率的放射图修复. 这些结果表明,拟议框架具有实际边缘部署的潜力,同时为今后利用真正的低剂量临床数据和以放射学家为基础的评估进行验证奠定了基础。
